title: Error reasons
description: Every typed error.details.reason value that agent-device declares in a reason table, grouped by command and subsystem.

<!-- Generated by `pnpm generate:reasons` from the reason tables in the source. Do not edit. -->

A failed command can name why it failed in `error.details.reason`. Branch on the reason, not on the message: a message can change, and a published reason keeps its spelling.

Treat a reason that this page does not list as unknown, not as an error in the response: a newer daemon or a provider plugin can add reasons. [Commands](/docs/commands) documents more reasons with the behavior of each command.

## Commands

### `alert`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `alert-wait-window-too-long` | `alert wait` was given a longer window than it can honour; the command refuses it before running and never shortens it. `details.maxWaitWindowMs` names the limit. |

### `audit`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `native-audit-invalid-result` | The runner answered the native audit with a missing or malformed result. |

### `batch`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `bounded_composite_resource_unsupported` | The step drives a long-lived resource (a recording, trace, log, audio, or perf capture, or a session resource awaiting recovery), so it must run as its own command; `details.shape` names the refused operation and `details.standaloneCommandName` the command. The refused step did not dispatch; earlier steps may have. |

### `clipboard`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android_clipboard_shell_command_unavailable` | This Android build ships no shell command for the clipboard service. |

### `close`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android-app-close-timeout` | A stop fence ended before the app left the foreground or its killed processes exited. |
| `android-process-probe-unavailable` | `adb pidof` or the resumed-activity read did not answer, so process state is unknown. |
| `MACOS_APP_TERMINATION_TIMEOUT` | The macOS app was still running after every termination attempt. |

### `events`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `EVENT_LOG_CURSOR_EXPIRED` | The cursor names a line that rotation has already removed from the retained window. |
| `EVENT_LOG_WINDOW_UNVERIFIED` | The retained event log files or their window sidecar are malformed, incomplete, or disagree, so no cursor can be trusted. |

### `fill`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android_shell_text_unsupported` | The adb-shell fallback carries ASCII text only; a helper or provider channel is needed. |
| `android_ime_helper_no_ack` | The test IME helper gave no evidence it attempted the dispatch, so nothing is proven typed. |
| `android_ime_helper_dispatch_rejected` | The test IME helper answered that it rejected the dispatch, so nothing was typed. |
| `fill_record_as_requires_armed_recording` | `fill --record-as` needs an armed script recording; open a session with `--save-script` first. |
| `fill_text_stdin_unparameterized_recording` | `fill --text-stdin` needs `--record-as` or `--no-record` while a recording is armed, so the stdin text stays out of the script. |
| `android_test_ime_rebind_unconfirmed` | The test IME rebind could not be confirmed, so the focused field may have no input session. |

### `find`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `find_snapshot_unreadable` | The capture came back sparse, so no selector could be resolved against it. |

### `fold`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `single-panel-device` | The device has one panel and no hinge, so there is no pose to set. |
| `fold-pose-unverified` | The pose was sent, but the device still reports another pose. |
| `fold-posture-unsupported` | The emulator profile has no device state for the requested pose; `details.supportedPoses` lists the poses it has. |
| `fold-keyframes-unsupported` | Android poses fixed postures only, so fold keyframes are refused. |
| `fold-posture-dispatch-failed` | The Android emulator console refused the posture command. |
| `fold-lock-screen-persists` | The lock screen that folding raised on Android did not stay dismissed. |
| `fold-hinge-angle-unreadable` | The Android emulator console returned no hinge angle. |
| `fold-helper-build-failed` | The iOS simulator fold helper could not be built with the selected Xcode. |
| `fold-hid-dispatch-failed` | The fold helper could not send the hinge pose to the iOS simulator. |
| `fold-hinge-angle-no-sample` | An iOS simulator hinge read returned no usable sample; `details` say why. |
| `fold-pose-dispatched-unverified` | The iOS simulator received the pose, but the first hinge read returned no sample to verify it. |
| `fold-angle-unverified` | The iOS simulator hinge did not reach the angle of the final keyframe. |
| `fold-pose-unsettled` | The iOS simulator hinge reached the pose but never came to rest. |

| `ARTIFACT_BYTE_LIMIT` | The response declared or carried more bytes than the artifact budget allows. |
| `source_materialization_deadline_exceeded` | The aggregate or handed-down materialization budget ran out before the source was ready. |

### `open`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `claim-lost-during-open` | The device lost the claim this open was made with; close the session and open the device again. |
| `runtime-hints-operation-missing` | Runtime hints were requested, but the device runtime admitted no operation to apply or clear them. |
| `android_port_reverse_rebind_refused` | The endpoint already has a device mapping, which a `--no-rebind` reverse never replaces. |
| `invalid-android-activity-component` | The `--activity` value is not an Android component name. |
| `android-launch-not-foreground` | The app the helper launched never reached the foreground before the launch budget ran out. |
| `android-app-close-timeout` | A stop fence ended before the app left the foreground or its killed processes exited. |
| `android-process-probe-unavailable` | `adb pidof` or the resumed-activity read did not answer, so process state is unknown. |
| `ios-simulator-openurl-timeout` | CoreSimulator did not answer `simctl openurl` in time, so the URL open failed. |
| `system-surface-host-not-openable` | The bundle hosts an iOS system surface, which `open` refuses to launch as an app. |
| `launch_confirmation_foreign_app` | iOS asks to open another app's URL scheme instead of the session app's. |
| `launch_confirmation_unanswered` | The Simulator has not completed the launch URL; an "Open in" prompt may still be waiting. |

### `record`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android_screenrecord_startup_failed` | Android `screenrecord` exited before it began writing; its startup output says why. |
| `native_recovery_evidence_unavailable` | The marker exists but the device could not be read, so it cannot be classified. |
| `native_recovery_evidence_unreadable` | The marker exists but does not decode, so nothing about it can be verified. |
| `native_recovery_evidence_transport_mismatch` | The marker was written by the other adb transport, so this one must not retire it. |
| `native_recovery_evidence_open` | An open recording still owns the marker; only its own session's stop or close retires it. |
| `native_recording_artifact_claimed` | A recorder is still writing the pending artifact, so removing it would cut a clip short. |
| `native_recording_artifact_removal_failed` | The device refused to remove the pending artifact, so the marker has to stay. |
| `native_recovery_evidence_retirement_unconfirmed` | The marker read back after removal, so its retirement is not proven. |
| `native_recording_recorder_unproven` | The probe could not prove no recorder is writing the pending artifact. |
| `recording_destination_not_requested` | A remote recording was saved to the current directory because the request named no destination; a warning. |

### `replay`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `wait_landmark_identity_mismatch` | A replay destination guard refused the match because its identity differs from the recorded landmark. |
| `bounded_composite_resource_unsupported` | The step drives a long-lived resource (a recording, trace, log, audio, or perf capture, or a session resource awaiting recovery), so it must run as its own command; `details.shape` names the refused operation and `details.standaloneCommandName` the command. The refused step did not dispatch; earlier steps may have. |
| `android-process-probe-unavailable` | `adb pidof` or the resumed-activity read did not answer, so process state is unknown. |
| `android-kill-process-survived` | `am kill` returned and the process is still running; force-stop it instead. |
| `android-kill-requires-background-app` | `am kill` only reaps background processes, so it refuses the foreground app. |

### `screenshot`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `CROP_SELECTOR_INVALID` | The `--crop-on` value is not a valid selector expression. |
| `CROP_TARGET_NOT_FOUND` | No element matches the `--crop-on` selector. |
| `CROP_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one element matches the `--crop-on` selector. |
| `CROP_CAPTURE_UNREADABLE` | The snapshot taken for `--crop-on` was too sparse to read as the screen. |
| `CROP_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE` | The snapshot taken for `--crop-on` was truncated, so a missing match is not proven. |
| `CROP_EMPTY_INTERSECTION` | The target frame covers no pixel of the capture. |
| `CROP_PARTIAL_INTERSECTION` | The target frame extends past the image, so the crop was clipped; a warning, not a failure. |
| `CROP_TARGET_NOT_ACCEPTED` | `--crop-on` is not supported on this device, surface, or snapshot backend. |
| `CROP_FRAME_MISMATCH` | `--crop-on` was combined with `--overlay-refs` or `--fullscreen`, which move the captured frame. |
| `PENDING_PIXEL_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE` | The `details.rejectionReason` of a target whose crop is not yet verified against an independent capture. |
| `SCREENSHOT_FULLSCREEN_MACOS_HELPER_SURFACE_FIXED_FRAME` | `--fullscreen` names a macOS helper surface, which always captures the main display. |
| `screenshot_publication_failed` | Writing the screenshot to its output path failed; `details.filesystemCode` names the error. |
| `screenshot_destination_dangling_symlink` | The output path is a symbolic link to a file that does not exist. |
| `screenshot_destination_not_file` | The output path exists and is not a regular file. |
| `simulator-screenshot-timeout` | `simctl io screenshot` timed out (ETIMEDOUT) on the simulator. |

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `scroll_no_progress` | A directional scroll did not move a container that still hides content. |
| `scroll_keyboard_occludes_surface` | The on-screen keyboard leaves too little of the scroll surface to scroll. |
| `scroll_refresh_not_at_top` | `scroll refresh` started away from the top of the content. |

| `scroll_until_edge_reached` | `--until` reached the end of the content before the selector was visible. |

| `scroll_until_capture_unreadable` | `--until` could not read the screen between passes. |
| `scroll_edge_pass_limit` | `scroll top` or `scroll bottom` reached its pass limit before the edge. |
| `scroll_edge_no_progress` | The `scroll top` or `scroll bottom` gestures did not move the content. |
| `scroll_edge_capture_unreadable` | `scroll top` or `scroll bottom` could not read the screen between passes. |

### `wait`

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `wait_capture_stalled` | No readable capture arrived before the deadline, so a retry can succeed. |
| `wait_deadline_exceeded` | A later capture used up the budget after an earlier readable capture. |
| `wait_runner_restart_exhausted` | The deadline ended while the runner restarted to recover a lost response, so a retry can succeed. |
| `wait_readiness_exhausted` | The deadline ended while the target was still being made observable; `details.readinessPhase` names the work. |
| `wait_target_absent` | A positive wait never found a match. |
| `wait_target_present` | Strict `wait absent` reached its deadline while valid captures still contained matches. |
| `wait_stable_timeout` | `wait stable` reached its deadline before the UI settled. |
| `wait_landmark_identity_mismatch` | A replay destination guard refused the match because its identity differs from the recorded landmark. |

## Subsystems

These reasons can come from more than one command.

### Swift helper cache

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `swift_cache_untrusted` | The Swift helper cache, a helper compiled into it, or the selected `DEVELOPER_DIR` is not a trusted path that only this user or root can change. |

### Android adb port reverse

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android_port_reverse_rebind_refused` | The endpoint already has a device mapping, which a `--no-rebind` reverse never replaces. |

### Android adb transport

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `managed-device-transport-mismatch` | The call aimed a managed adb transport at another device, target, or server. |

### Android helper install

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `missing` | The device has no package installed under the helper's name. |
| `outdated` | The installed helper's versionCode is below the bundled artifact's. |
| `mismatched` | The installed helper matches the artifact's versionCode but not its APK checksum. |
| `unverifiable` | The installed helper's APK checksum could not be read, so its currency stays unproven. |

### Android input

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android-input-budget-exhausted` | The request had no room left for one helper input attempt, so nothing was sent. |

### Android snapshot helper

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android-snapshot-helper-not-current` | A current-only check found no current helper: nothing ran, so there is nothing to recover. |
| `android_snapshot_helper_runtime_occupied` | Another helper process still holds UiAutomation, so nothing can take the runtime. |
| `android_snapshot_helper_session_request_timeout` | The helper accepted the session request but sent no answer before the command deadline. |
| `android_snapshot_helper_session_peer_unverified` | The listener could not prove the session secret, so it is not the helper this session launched. |
| `android_snapshot_helper_session_ready_timeout` | The helper process never reported readiness before the readiness budget ran out. |
| `android_snapshot_helper_session_ready_malformed` | The readiness record the helper sent does not prove this session's protocol, socket, or secret. |
| `android_snapshot_helper_session_exited_before_ready` | The helper process ended before it reported readiness. |

### Android text channel

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `android_shell_text_unsupported` | The adb-shell fallback carries ASCII text only; a helper or provider channel is needed. |
| `android_ime_helper_no_ack` | The test IME helper gave no evidence it attempted the dispatch, so nothing is proven typed. |
| `android_ime_helper_dispatch_rejected` | The test IME helper answered that it rejected the dispatch, so nothing was typed. |

### Apple app resolution

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `app-list-unreadable` | `simctl` produced no list of the simulator's installed apps, so the app could not be resolved. |

### Apple runner

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `apple_runner_host_unbound` | The Apple runner was asked for its host before the daemon bound one. |

### Artifact downloads

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `artifact_size_mismatch` | The artifact stream ended at a different size than the daemon recorded; `details` gives both sizes. |

### Artifact extraction

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ARCHIVE_ENTRY_LIMIT` | The archive holds more entries than the extraction budget allows. |
| `ARCHIVE_EXPANDED_BYTES_LIMIT` | The archive expands past the byte budget its extraction was given. |
| `ARCHIVE_INVALID_ENTRY` | An archive entry states a size that is not a usable non-negative integer. |
| `ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_MISMATCH` | The archive's contents changed between the manifest that reserved the budget and the bytes read. |
| `ARCHIVE_NESTING_LIMIT` | The archive nests deeper than the allowed archive-within-archive depth. |
| `ARCHIVE_UNSAFE_ENTRY` | The archive holds a link, a special file, or an encrypted entry. |
| `ARCHIVE_UNSAFE_PATH` | An archive entry's name is absolute, escaping, or otherwise not one relative path. |

### Daemon lifecycle

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `daemon-not-running` | An attaching client found no daemon to connect to. |
| `daemon-incompatible` | The running daemon does not match the client; `details.daemon` and `details.client` hold both identities. |
| `daemon-drain-timeout` | A daemon accepted the request to leave but was still running 60 s later and could not be retired. |
| `daemon_state_root_unsafe` | The state directory, or a directory above it, is not private to your account; `details.fix` says how to fix it. |
| `daemon-busy` | The daemon still holds work, so it refused to leave; `details` counts that work. |
| `daemon-instance-mismatch` | The request names a different daemon instance than the one answering it. |
| `daemon-owner-embedded` | A live host process owns this daemon and ends it through its own `close()`. |
| `daemon_shutting_down` | The daemon has begun to leave, so it refuses every new request; retry against a new daemon. |
| `daemon_registration_refused` | Another daemon holds this state directory, or its registration could not be proven free, so this daemon did not start; `details.status` says which. |

### Daemon policy

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `DAEMON_POLICY_DENIED` | The daemon operator's policy denies this command, device, capability, or lease; `details.rule` names which. |

### Daemon resources

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `RESOURCE_EXPIRED` | The artifact, upload, or path id expired or never existed; the daemon cannot tell which. |

### Daemon runtime

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `interactor-resolution-missing` | This process never composed interactor resolution, so it cannot reach a device. |
| `runtime-gateway-missing` | The daemon was composed without the runtime gateway, admission ledger, or diagnostics service this command needs. |
| `request_web_session_missing` | A request reached device resolution without the web session its request scope derives; this is a daemon bug. |
| `generic-route-runtime-missing` | The command reached the generic route, which has no runtime execution for it. |

### Device claims

| --- | --- |
| `DEVICE_CLAIM_LIVE_OWNER` | A live session in another workspace or daemon owns the device. |
| `DEVICE_CLAIM_RECOVERY_PENDING` | The recorded owner is gone and its resources still need settling before the claim is released. |
| `DEVICE_CLAIM_OWNER_UNCERTAIN` | A claim exists, but its owner cannot be verified as live or gone. |

### Interaction

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `selector_not_found` | No element matches the selector. |
| `predicate_failed` | The element does not satisfy the asserted state, or strict absence could not be proven. |
| `ref_not_found` | The `@ref` names no node of the stored snapshot; take a new snapshot. |
| `ref_unlabeled` | The `@ref` names a node with no label to wait on or scope by. |
| `target_bounds_invalid` | The target has no usable center to touch. |
| `target_covered` | Another visible element covers the target; `details.coveredBy` names it when known. |
| `target_not_hittable` | The platform reports the target as not hittable, so nothing was pressed. |
| `target_disabled` | `find focus` or `find type` resolved to a disabled text field. |
| `target_still_moving` | The target did not come to rest before the press; wait for the screen, then retry. |

### Leases

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `LEASE_NOT_FOUND` | The lease that the request names is not active. |
| `LEASE_SCOPE_MISMATCH` | The lease does not match the tenant, run, backend, provider, device, or client of the request. |
| `LEASE_SCOPE_REQUIRED` | The lease was allocated with an owner scope that the request does not repeat. |
| `provider-instance-ended` | The device instance behind the lease ended outside the daemon, which ends the lease with it. |
| `DEVICE_LEASE_BUSY` | Another lease, or this tenant run, already holds the device; retry after that lease is released or expires. |
| `LEASE_ID_IN_USE` | The requested lease id already names a lease that this daemon issued. |
| `LEASE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED` | Every iOS simulator lease slot is taken; retry after another lease is released. |
| `MACOS_APP_LEASE_DENIED` | A `macos-app` lease does not cover this request; `details.rule` names the limit. |
| `provider-not-registered` | The lease names a provider this daemon has not registered; `details.failedPlugins` lists plugins that failed to load. |
| `provider-credentials-changed` | The running daemon holds different provider credentials than this shell; stop the daemon and rerun. |
| `PROVIDER_SESSION_NOT_OWNED` | The provider session belongs to another tenant. |
| `MACOS_APP_LEASE_HOST_OWNED` | Only the host administrator releases a `macos-app` lease. |
| `MACOS_APP_LEASE_HOST_ALLOCATED` | Only the host administrator allocates a `macos-app` lease. |
| `LEASE_SESSION_MISMATCH` | The lease scope of the request differs from the lease of its session; `details.field` names the field. |
| `LEASE_LEDGER_OVERWRITE` | The CLI already tracks an allocated lease and must release or transfer it before it allocates another. |

### Limrun provider

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `limrun_adb_tunnel_cleaned_up` | The ADB tunnel of this lease was already cleaned up, so nothing can be typed over it. |
| `limrun_instance_unreachable` | The instance stopped answering, so its app state cannot be read. |
| `limrun_instance_delete_unconfirmed` | A release could not confirm Limrun deleted the instance, so it may still be billed. |
| `limrun_lease_released_mid_allocation` | The lease was released while its instance was still being prepared for the allocation. |
| `limrun_lease_not_live` | The lease holds no live session, so the command that addresses it has nothing to act on. |
| `limrun_runtime_shut_down` | This runtime is shut down, so it refuses to allocate a lease into it. |
| `limrun_app_sync_retired` | The app-sync session of this lease has ended, so no further sync runs on it. |
| `limrun_app_sync_failed` | App sync or local cache maintenance failed; check the device for the app before retrying. |

### Macos helper

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `background-pointer-gesture` | A double-click or press-and-hold has no accessibility equivalent in a background macOS app. |
| `no-accessible-target` | No accessibility element the action can use is at the point. |
| `no-settable-text-input` | No settable text input is at the point, or the input refused the new value. |
| `no-scroll-bar` | No scroll area with a settable scroll bar is under the front window's center. |
| `no-context-menu` | No element at the point offers a context menu. |
| `window-not-found` | The app has no on-screen window on the current Space. |
| `front-window-capture-excluded` | The app excludes its front window from screen capture; use `snapshot` to read it. |
| `front-window-not-shareable` | ScreenCaptureKit does not offer the front window, for example while it opens or closes. |
| `context-menu-not-observed` | The element offered a context menu, but no menu window appeared. |
| `window-list-unreadable` | The app's on-screen window list could not be read. |
| `event_creation_failed` | macOS could not create the keyboard or mouse event to post. |
| `missing_button` | No button on the alert fits the requested accept or dismiss. |

### Process lock

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `process_lock_guard_release_failed` | The guard that serialises lock-directory mutations could not confirm its own release. |
| `process_lock_timeout` | The caller gave up waiting for a lock another owner held. |

### Process stop

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `signal-failed` | The host refused the signal, usually because another user owns the process. |
| `exit-timeout` | SIGKILL was sent and nothing proved the process exited within the budget it was given. |
| `identity-unverified` | Nothing confirmed the pid names the recorded process, so signalling it was refused. |

### Provider runtime

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `provider-session-unavailable` | The provider's session for the device ended, so the runtime has nothing left to serve. |

### Ref frames

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ref_frame_expired` | A device action since the snapshot expired the ref frame, so none of its refs resolve. |
| `ref_generation_mismatch` | The pinned ref was minted from a snapshot generation that a newer one superseded. |
| `plain_ref_requires_complete_frame` | A plain ref needs a complete frame. Retry with the pinned ref in `details.suggestedRef` when present; otherwise capture a fresh interactive snapshot or use a stable selector. |
| `ref_not_issued` | The current ref frame did not issue this ref, so it no longer names a node. |

### Remote connection

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `REMOTE_SESSION_REQUIRED` | A command on a leased remote connection, or one that would lease one, named no session. |

### Remote daemon

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `REMOTE_HOST_INPUT_DENIED` | A remote request supplied a host path or other host input (`details.field`), which a remote daemon refuses. |

### Remote transfer

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `artifact_too_large` | The remote artifact is larger than the bytes this download may hold. |
| `remote_script_lifecycle_unsupported` | `--save-script` was asked for on a command whose script lifecycle the daemon does not remote. |
| `artifact_preparation_deadline_exceeded` | Preparing the artifact for upload, the read and the hop together, outlived its budget. |
| `cross-origin-redirect` | The upload endpoint answered with a redirect to an origin the caller never named. |

### Request admission

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `session_app_required` | A per-app setting was requested, but the session binds no app and the request names none. |
| `session_or_device_selector_required` | The request has neither an active session nor a device selector. |
| `named_session_not_found` | The request names a session that this daemon does not hold. |
| `app_not_installed` | The named app resolves to no installed app on the target. |
| `malformed_request` | The transport refused the request envelope before any handler read it. |

### Request cancellation

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `duplicate_request_id` | A request arrived with an id another request is still in flight under. |

### Request execution

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `DEVICE_EXECUTION_LOCK_BUSY` | Another request is using the device while this request holds another device of the same host; run the step as its own request. |

### Revyl provider

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `invalid_provider_app` | Revyl installs the app from a URL, so `--provider-app` cannot name a local file. |
| `unsupported_platform` | Revyl rents an iOS simulator or an Android emulator, and the request names neither. |
| `missing_provider_credentials` | No Revyl API key is set, so the provider cannot authenticate the request. |
| `unsupported_app_artifact` | Revyl installs an iOS simulator build or an Android .apk, and the build is neither. |
| `provider-app-not-launched` | The session runs no app, so a close or setting that names one has nothing to act on. |
| `provider-viewport-unavailable` | The session reports no viewport, so a scroll distance or screenshot density has nothing to scale by. |
| `provider-invalid-response` | Revyl answered a worker action with a value outside the field's own range. |
| `provider-refused` | Revyl refused the request or the action it carries. |
| `provider-response-invalid` | Revyl answered in a way agent-device cannot read, such as a body that is not JSON. |
| `provider-unconfirmed` | agent-device could not confirm the outcome of the request; check the session before retrying. |
| `provider-unreachable` | Revyl never answered the request, or the connection to its backend failed. |
| `provider-auth-rejected` | Revyl rejected the credentials on the request. |
| `provider-session-gone` | The session the request addresses no longer exists at Revyl. |
| `provider-conflict` | Revyl rejected the request because its state conflicts with what it asks for. |
| `provider-request-failed` | Revyl refused a request it never routed, with a status that settles the failure. |
| `request_timeout` | Revyl gave no response before the request's own deadline passed. |
| `invalid_provider_url` | `REVYL_API_URL` is not an origin Revyl's API can be addressed at. |
| `provider-session-identity-mismatch` | Revyl started a session under an identity agent-device did not issue for the lease. |
| `provider-start-refused` | Revyl refused to start the device and named why in its start answer. |
| `provider-start-failed` | Revyl's worker connection ended in a state that never serves the device. |
| `provider-not-ready` | Revyl never reported a ready device within the wait the caller could spend. |
| `provider-cleanup-pending` | Revyl did not confirm it released the session, which stays rented and billed until it does. |
| `provider-lease-releasing` | The lease is being released, so it cannot serve another allocation. |
| `runtime-shutting-down` | The provider runtime is ending the sessions it holds, so it takes no new work. |
| `provider-lease-request-mismatch` | An allocation joins a lease whose device was started for another app or device. |

### Script publication

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `script_ancestor_untrusted` | The script path is not one absolute file name under existing directories private to this user. |

### Script recording

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `script_write_failed` | Writing the session script failed; check the target path and its permissions, then record again. |

### Sessions

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `WORKSPACE_SESSION_SCOPE_CONFLICT` | A session in another workspace already uses the device; `details.session` names it. |
| `session_address_occupied` | Another live session already holds this session address. |
| `session_lifetime_ended` | The session the command ran in ended first; open a new session before retrying. |
| `SESSION_IDLE_EXPIRED` | The session expired after its idle window (`details.idleExpiryMs`); run `open` to start a new one. |
| `session_cleanup_incomplete` | The session was retired, but some of its resources did not release; `details.failedSteps` names them. |

### Snapshot capture

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ios_app_session_required` | The iOS command needs an active app session on the target device; run `open` first. |
| `runner-snapshot-bridge-target-unavailable` | The runner could not name the app's foreground process; `details.bridgeFailureCode` says why. |
| `simulator-target-discovery-pending` | The wait ran out while the discovery of the app's simulator process was still running. |
| `simulator-target-unavailable` | The app has no running process on the simulator. |
| `simulator-target-probe-failed` | The simulator could not be asked for its running apps. |
| `simulator-target-identity-unavailable` | The app's simulator process was found, but its identity could not be read. |
| `simulator-runtime-probe-failed` | The simulator could not be asked for its runtime. |
| `simulator-runtime-unavailable` | The simulator reported no runtime. |

### Timeouts

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `daemon_request_timeout` | The daemon request's deadline left no time to finish its work. |
| `operation_deadline_expired` | An `AbortSignal.timeout` ended the wait before the operation it guarded finished. |

### Uploads

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `UPLOAD_STATE_CORRUPT` | The staged upload holds more bytes than it declared, so it cannot resume; start a new upload. |
| `UPLOAD_ROLLBACK_FAILED` | A failed chunk could not be rolled back, so the upload ticket was invalidated; start a new upload. |
| `UPLOAD_FINALIZE_CLEANUP_FAILED` | Finalizing the upload failed, and removing its staged files failed too; `details.originalError` holds the first failure. |
| `transfer_ingress_deadline_exceeded` | The upload request exceeded its aggregate deadline (`details.timeoutMs`), which also covers processing after the body arrived. |
| `upload_canceled` | The client disconnected or canceled before the upload finished. |

### Web session naming

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `web_session_name_invalid` | The session name is longer than the backend key allows or holds a character it rejects. |

### Webdriver provider

| Reason | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `provider_session_create_timeout` | The provider did not create the WebDriver session within the session-creation budget. |
| `provider_session_released_during_allocation` | Releasing the lease interrupted the allocation; `details.cleanup` reports how cleanup ended. |
| `provider_session_shutdown_during_allocation` | The WebDriver runtime could not finish the allocation: shutdown was in progress or done. |
| `provider_session_release_in_progress` | The lease is still releasing its previous session, so a new allocation gets no session. |
| `provider_session_cleanup_incomplete` | Shutdown could not confirm that all WebDriver sessions and provider resources were cleaned up. |
| `text_entry_clear_target_unavailable` | `fill` has no focused element reference to clear before it types the replacement text. |
| `webdriver_request_timeout` | The transport stopped waiting on a WebDriver request the driver may still be carrying out. |
| `webdriver_connect_refused` | The request never reached the driver: the connection was refused or the host is unreachable. |
| `webdriver_request_interrupted` | The connection to the driver failed after the request may have reached it. |
| `webdriver_route_unsupported` | The driver answered that it does not implement the route. |
| `hub_app_upload_timeout` | The app upload to the provider's storage did not answer within its own deadline. |
| `hub_app_upload_transport_failed` | The app upload to the provider's storage never completed its transport. |
| `provider_app_cwd_missing` | `--provider-app` is a relative path and the request names no working directory to resolve it in. |
